title: OpenBot: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own
description:
OpenBot gives each agent its own container with its own Chromium, logins, and workspace, so two coworkers aren't sharing a browser profile. Every tool call routes through one gateway that resolves the target, checks it against your rules, writes an audit row, and only then acts, or refuses and names the rule. Any AG-UI endpoint plugs in. It's alpha, ships with auth disabled, and needs a CopilotKit Intelligence licence to run. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/CopilotKit/openbot
